name: rw-cloud-personal-worker
description: Personal, self-hosted RW Studio cloud and cooperative editing backend on Cloudflare.

RW_BOOTSTRAP_SECRET.description: Paste the one-time 48-character setup secret generated by RW Studio. Keep it private; it encrypts access codes and sessions.

RW_BUCKET.description: R2 bucket that stores the user's RW Studio projects. Cloudflare can create it automatically.

RW_ACCOUNT.description: Durable Object used for personal RW Cloud setup and project registry.

RW_PROJECTS.description: Durable Objects used for participants, presence, locks, invitations and history.
